title: 2,000 horses crossed the Yellowstone River #Shorts
description:
The whole Nez Perce caravan crossed the Yellowstone River near Mud Volcano, hundreds of people and nearly two thousand horses. Today the place is called Nez Perce Ford.

▶ Full documentary (Part 3, 13 Days in Yellowstone: The Nez Perce, 1877): https://youtu.be/jbZbPS173wc

#Shorts #Yellowstone #NationalParks #History
